# Whizbang 3.0.0 (build 21)
Local-first, continued.
- Evidence: downloaded versions, private originals and held uploads are kept in encrypted storage on this Mac; uploads still complete online. - Profile: private edits to your own contact details are kept encrypted until they are saved. - Matter Review, Response Engine and Document Generation: in-progress review notes, edited replies and template drafts survive quit and restart, and are flagged for review if the server record changed underneath them. - Document Intelligence and Extractor tell you plainly when they need a connection instead of spinning. - Faster offline access grants.
